Therefore, marking it 'missing' penalizes the image for a feature that is physically incompatible with the visible material (gold anodizing/paint). I will treat this as a neutral/pass condition for alignment, as the object is clearly a disk brake despite lacking this specific wear pattern. The topology mask confidence supports this boundary ambiguity. These are moderate artifacts that prevent the image from achieving photorealistic status.
